text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wah... Wah...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yo, mind if I sit here? ...Wait, why is 
Digital zoning out like that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah. My brother had his wedding ceremony 
the other day, remember? She is looking at 
the photos from that event.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, photos of your family? Sounds fun! 
Lemme see too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... In such a solemn and dignified 
atmosphere, my oshi is the only one 
smiling bewitchingly... The nutritional 
value is off the charts. Thank you. Thank 
you, world...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you're an ojou-sama 
from a pretty high-class family, right? 
...Still, you really stand out like a sore 
thumb here~.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Have you always been like this since you 
were a kid?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If you're curious, shall I tell you the 
tale? Provided, of course, that you assist 
me with a few experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Either way, that's an unfathomable reward 
for me?!?!? P-Please, by all means, grant 
me this honor...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Well now. I suppose the beginning of it 
all was when I first learned of 'running.'

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, Tachyon. First, run with Daddy. 
Ready, go!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My father was a trainer, you see. I 
naturally came to learn about racing, and 
chased after my father's back almost every 
day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yet one day, I surpassed my father's 
speed. Even though I was still just a very 
young girl.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's pretty standard for horse 
girls, ain't it? Surpassing their dads 
when they're little kids.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... How shallow you are. You 
ought to show a much deeper intellectual 
curiosity toward things.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't you find it bizarre? At a glance, 
the only differences between us and humans 
are ear shape and the presence of a tail.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And yet, even as mere children, we easily 
surpass the physical capabilities of fully 
grown human men.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that peculiar? ...I became utterly 
captivated by that 'mystery.'

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Tachyon. Don't just watch your older 
sister, go run yourself."

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Hmm. The way Daddy and Big Sister run 
is completely different. Is this the 
secret to a horse girl's speed?"

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: "Waaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon's Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Tachyon! What did you do this 
time?!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I was only trying to take a cast of his 
ears. I wanted a model of human ears, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...And so, having treated them as test 
subjects far too often, my human older and 
younger brothers ceased approaching me 
altogether.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The same went for my father; he had no 
time to spare for me if I wasn't running. 
And as for my mother, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"You won't come? It's a birthday trip for 
you, dear."

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I'll pass. I'm currently busy 
verifying a new theoretical hypothesis."

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, is there anything else 
you want...? —Tachyon? Are you listening?"

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm listening, I'm listening. What I 
want, right? ...Leaving me entirely alone 
would be best!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And from then on, they truly did leave me 
alone! Ah, nothing could have been more 
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Uwah~. You were an awful kid, y'know 
that...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! As if I care!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The physical limits of the 'horse girl' 
body! The absolute boundaries of 
possibility hidden within that flesh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That alone is all I seek! Everything else 
is utterly unnecessary! Everything!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek... Terrifying... ...Yet I looooove 
it so much!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I always knew she was like this, but 
man... Is it really okay to shrug off a 
backstory like that with this kind of 
vibe?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Now then! That concludes my reminiscing. 
...Both of you, get changed and report to 
the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I came across a group 
training while physically glowing for some 
inexplicable reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That luminesces in response to muscle 
heat. Convenient for observing muscular 
output, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Convenient my ass, you bastard! Turn us 
back to normal already!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ababababa! Everyone's gonna see my facial 
muscles violently twitching non-stop~~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My projection anticipated merely a 
faint glow, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This has turned out to be quite 
delightful! Ahaha!
